summary.en: A girl named Funako Nakai came to Mouri Detective Agency asking for help to search someone named Kazuma Hikone, but Kogoro refused to help. Funako Nakai then came to Kazuma's house to find him and Conan followed her. Conan asked Kazuma's neighbor, Takashi Kiyose if he noticed something strange about Kazuma and at the same time, another neighbor named Akio Nashida suddenly burst out after hearing noise and claimed that he didn't know. When Conan got back to the house, he felt that someone is watching them and asked Funako if the notebook was the reason why she couldn't go to the police. Funako then gave the notebook to Conan and he immediately read what was inside the notebook. It was titled "Crime Plan", containing an article about how to rob a particular place. Missing Person? Murder? Victim: Kazuma Hikone Kazuma Hikone had been missing for two whole days. Later, Ishigama Jewelry is robbed. Conan then go to the crime scene and meet Takagi. Location: Ishigama Jewelry Suspects: Unknown Culprit The robbery method turns out to be the same as what was written on the notebook. Can Conan figure out where is Kazuma? And if he really robbed the bank?
